notes.title: Another update to Comrades and Barons: Gates of Freedom
notes.content:
The German translation is added to the game!
Also, the demo is fixed no to crash, since some people still download it.

The video about the events retold in the game "A Brief Overview of the Latvian War of Independence, 1918-1920" can be viewed here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HMspM6h-evw

Oh right! If you own the game, leave a review, please!

notes.title: An update to Comrades and Barons: Gates of Freedom
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604202/b69a89e5d49dd5e75360d967fc059c399816a978.jpg[/img]
A update to Comrades and Barons: Gates of Freedom, a wargame about Freedom War of Latvia.
Firstly, the game now has about thirty Steam achievements.
Secondly, the game runs faster even with many units on the screen.
Thirdly, Steam overlay should be fully available.
Enjoy and tell me, if some of it doesn't work!

Discord: https://discord.gg/StwnxP6
